//: Sample Claude Code settings wiring chain_check.py as a deterministic gate.
//1: Hooks are deterministic; skills are advisory. Back a critical policy with a hook.
//2: This PreToolUse hook runs before any git commit/push. If the artifact chain
//3: is broken (an approved intent/spec/plan was edited after sign-off), the
//4: command is blocked. Point --dir at wherever your artifacts live.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then python3 code/159-artifact-chain/chain_check.py --dir ./intent || { echo 'Artifact chain broken: reseal after review before committing.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi
